name: Vuk Edlund-Gyan
role: Corporate espionage and data exfiltration — data thief
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near State and Madison
description:
Vuk Edlund-Gyan is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 54, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex b — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She taught herself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know her best. She works as a data thief out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Vuk Edlund-Gyan lacks in subtlety, she compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Vuk Edlund-Gyan maintains a second identity — a completely clean civilian persona with a lease, a job history, and a social profile. It's their exit strategy.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
example_lines: "Your firewalls are decorative. Like curtains on a submarine."
"I copy things. The original owners rarely appreciate the compliment."
"Data wants to be free. I just charge a facilitation fee."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Vuk Edlund-Gyan once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
A dead drop Vuk Edlund-Gyan maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A crew member from Vuk Edlund-Gyan's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Vuk Edlund-Gyan functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex bombs in others. Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, muscular through the shoulders and torso with a low center of gravity. Hands are large-knuckled and scarred, built for precision and force. No excess fat, but thick-boned and dense.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural dark roots showing
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, utilitarian braid, no vanity in the arrangement
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm brown with gray undertones, weathered by age and exposure
physical_description.complexion: Lined face, crow's feet and forehead creases that map decades of squinting at screens and problems. Scarred upper lip from an old break. Jawline still strong. Minimal makeup, rough-groomed.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone, surgical precision in the old wound
Burn scars across the backs of both hands in scattered patches, from reactive armor testing
Tattoo on right forearm: circuit board pattern in faded black, homemade work from her early twenties
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome cranial implant visible at the base of her skull where the synthetic port connects — a dark titanium-grade insert roughly the size of a thumbnail, deliberately left exposed. The surrounding scalp tissue shows fine scarring from the installation. No effort to conceal it.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced on the balls of her feet, ready to shift. Eyes constantly scanning. Her hands rest palms-down on tables, never crossed. When seated, she takes the chair with the best sightline to the door.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 utilitarian: dark reinforced synthweave jacket with cargo pockets, many of them loaded and zipped. Black tactical pants with knee reinforcement and thigh pockets. Scuffed boots rated for industrial environments. A gray undershirt visible at the collar. No logos, no affectation, no jewelry except a worn chronometer on her left wrist. Everything functional, nothing decorative.

She wears a dark reinforced synthweave jacket with cargo pockets, black tactical pants, and scuffed industrial boots. Her large hands are visibly scarred.
